assessment.active_frontier_recovery: Plan distinguishes authoritative event history from rebuildable projection, retains unknown active capacity and requires identity/cleanup checks; test plan should explicitly assert projection deletion/rebuild and duplicate replay across before/after projection commit.
assessment.core_authority_boundary: Coherent if authority API, storage, and rollback floor are actually outside coordinator write/rollback authority; coordinator SQLite/frontier and local files remain rebuildable caches.
assessment.fork_handling: Hash-chain plus unique serialized authority head can detect order internally, but the test plan should explicitly exercise split-brain clones/forks at identical domain+sequence and refuse to choose either without external anchoring.
assessment.minimal_safe_next_step: Disposable capacity-one authority reference over temp SQLite+CAS with explicit trusted_mutable_same_uid_reference label; run fake tiny commands and crash/idempotency/frontier tests only. Do not call it protected or production-grade.
remaining_infrastructure_blockers: SQLite/filesystem durability settings and supported storage assumptions
resource/lease integration and authority outage/unknown policy
assessment.rollback_handling: Expected-head/generation CAS plus separate retained monotonic checkpoint or authority-held floor is necessary; local projection/head cannot be its own trust anchor.
assessment.same_uid_boundary: Explicit and correct: same-UID reference, digests, chmod, hash chain, and adjacent head file do not resist coherent rewrite/rollback by their owner.
assessment.scientific_promotion: Explicitly separate from queue execution; accepted execution does not imply scientific source admission, fit, calibration, qualification or publication.

specific_test_plan_additions: two clones advance same domain/sequence to different heads; fresh nonce read and retained checkpoint must detect fork and stop launches
response replay with wrong/stale nonce or generation is rejected even if payload signature is valid
delete/corrupt coordinator projection at each authority event boundary; rebuild exact frontier and replay idempotently without duplicate reservation/release
release caller supplies a coherent-looking accepted terminal without authority/executor-bound receipt; reject or remain unknown
object publish succeeds but SQL commit/response is uncertain; idempotent lookup returns exactly committed identity; orphan object is never success
verdict: Sound source-only architecture with no current implementation or test evidence. No conceptual contradiction found, but fork/nonce and projection-rebuild test cases should be explicit before design is treated as implementation-ready. Strong protection remains blocked on separate infrastructure and trust-floor decisions.
